name: Armature
author: E. T. Carter
description: A solid dodecahedron sealed inside a glowing icosahedral wire cage that turns the opposite way — shaded surface and see-through edge-tubes in one frame, the two solids sliding against each other as they counter-rotate.

params.label: Cage
params.effect: Balance between the shaded core and the wire cage; low favours the solid, high makes the cage dominate.

params.label: Gauge
params.effect: Thickness of the cage edge-tubes, from hairline to fat bars.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness and bloom of the wire cage.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Counter-rotation speed of the core against the cage.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera; 0 ignores the mouse.
